scope: Assigned frozen item title and complete rendered ItemBody; excludes route navigation, dependency graph, and separate metadata Sources footer.

review_method.normative_instructions: CLAUDE.md read fully; README.md read fully; SCHEMA.md and WORKFLOW.md read for schema and workflow context.
review_method.rendering: Every assigned local PNG tile was opened individually with tools.view_image at original resolution; no downscaling or collage.
review_method.sources: Each complete ItemBody was read in the frozen snapshot/current byte-identical source and visually reviewed across its complete assigned rendered PNG tile sequence; each snapshot was checked byte-for-byte against current source and the rendered HTML/hash.
review_method.boundary: Read-only outside these two lane report files; no HTTP/live site; no item, app, or tool edits; no publication status changes; no tests, builds, commits, or pushes.

findings.title: ASCII caret and notation are displayed literally in the statement
findings.source_content: Let U⊂R^n be open and Y:U→R^n be C¹.
findings.displayed_content: The plain-text caret in R^n is visible; the exponent is not typeset as mathematical superscript.
findings.note: The line has no math delimiters. Its mathematical text is consequently emitted as ordinary prose with the ASCII caret.

findings.title: Undelimited subscript is displayed literally in the statement
findings.source_content: Let γ be an essential original loop and γ_t its short fixed-flow null fence boundaries. Every Jordan lifted disk cap of γ_t has projected image disjoint from γ and from one fixed intrinsic neighborhood of γ in its original leaf.
findings.displayed_content: The underscores in γ_t remain literal in the rendered sentence rather than becoming a subscript.
findings.note: The line has no math delimiters around γ_t; the underscore therefore appears as raw notation.

typography_observations.observation: Wikilinks in item bodies render as separate block lines in the assigned HTML and tiles; this is an expected renderer convention and was not recorded as a defect.
Technique banners use uppercase CSS styling as expected. No assigned proof-technique line contains inline math requiring a banner-specific rendering check.

source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.claim: The 4-dimensional example sets the middle boundary N≅S¹×S² and belt sphere B={p}×S²; γ₁ meets B transversely once and γ₂ is disjoint, so the column changes from (±1,0)ᵀ to (±1,±1)ᵀ after sliding g₂ over g₁, realizing R₂↦R₂±R₁.
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.warrant: A labeled before/after sketch can make the attaching-circle band sum, fixed belt sphere, single signed crossing, and resulting row operation easier to check together.
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.specific_content_to_draw_or_check: Show N=S¹×S², B={p}×S², γ₁ with one transverse intersection, γ₂ disjoint, a framed band sum for γ₂′, and label the intersection column before and after. The sign convention must agree with the chosen orientation of the single intersection.
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.certainty: uncertain candidate; the source determines all labels and matrix entries, but prose is already explicit and the diagram is optional.

source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.claim: On T²=Q×Q, A=Q×{[0]} and B={[0]}×Q have pairings A·A=B·B=0, A·B=1, B·A=−1, giving the displayed alternating matrix [[0,1],[-1,0]].
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.warrant: The sign/order convention is central to the worked claim; an oriented square model of the torus can show the two coordinate circles, their unique crossing, tangent order and push-offs establishing self-intersection zero.
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.specific_content_to_draw_or_check: Draw the square edge identifications for Q×Q, orient both coordinate circles by increasing coordinates and the torus by (∂x,∂y); mark their unique crossing with sign +1 in the order (A,B), and show parallel translations for A and B. The swapped order must have sign −1.
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.certainty: uncertain candidate; source and current formulas establish the sign data, so a diagram would be explanatory rather than necessary.

source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.claim: The Möbius band foliation is the quotient of ℝ×(−1,1) by k·(t,x)=(t+k,(−1)^k x); the core loop γ has reflection holonomy x↦−x, while 2γ is non-null-homotopic but has identity holonomy.
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.kind: foliated Möbius-band quotient and loop-holonomy schematic
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.warrant: A twisted-strip quotient diagram could clarify why the generator returns the transversal with a reflection, while traversing twice returns it identically even though the core loop class doubles rather than vanishes.
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.specific_content_to_draw_or_check: Show horizontal leaves on the covering strip, the gluing (1,x)∼(0,−x), a transversal coordinate x, one traversal γ inducing reflection, two traversals 2γ inducing identity, and the middle leaf/core circle. Preserve the distinction between equality of germs and distinct π₁ classes.
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.certainty: uncertain candidate; the quotient and calculations are explicit in prose, and a drawing must not suggest that 2γ is null-homotopic.

diagram_review.reason: No actual TikZ/tikzcd content diagrams occur in the assigned ItemBodies (all sidecars report tikz_count 0 and diagram_failures []); therefore there were no existing diagram maps, orientations, indices, or signs to check. Inline SVG elements in some HTML are KaTeX glyph/accent output rather than content diagrams. The three candidates are optional and source-grounded, not blanket requests for figures.

scratch_review.note: No Scratch section occurs in the assigned item bodies or frozen rendered HTML.

limitations: Review is limited to frozen local source, snapshots, HTML and screenshots; no live website or HTTP content was consulted.
No diagram candidate was treated as confirmed missing content; all three are uncertain optional illustrations.
